units.source_text: “……我从前也像方才那个孩子一样，骑在阿留姐的肩上，

en.t: "...Long ago, I too rode on Sister Aru's shoulders, just like that child a moment ago,

units.source_text: 战战兢兢地抱住阿留姐的头，站到她肩上，叉开双腿。

en.t: timidly clinging to Sister Aru's head, standing on her shoulders, and spreading my legs apart.

units.source_text: 阿留姐不也成了男人的玩物了？

en.t: Didn't Sister Aru also become a plaything for men?

units.source_text: 就说你吧，到那时你不是也只好认命吗……”

en.t: Take you, for example. When that time comes, won't you have no choice but to accept your fate too?..."
